title: 축의금 장부
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop and Synth-pop fusion. A clean, compressed electric guitar plays a rhythmic, palm-muted sixteenth-note pattern. The bass is a thick, analog-style synth that follows the kick drum with a syncopated groove. Drums consist of a crisp electronic snare and a punchy kick. A bright, polyphonic synth pad enters during the chorus. Male vocals are processed with light pitch correction and subtle doubling. The track is in the key of B Major at 118 BPM. The arrangement features a sudden transition from a sparse verse to a lush, layered chorus with shimmering synth leads.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
